mapper.select: SELECT d.DEPT_ID, d.DEPT_NAME, d.PARENT_ID, e.EMP_ID, e.EMP_NAME, p.POS_CODE, p.POS_NAME FROM DEPT d LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP e on d.DEPT_ID = e.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION p on e.POS_CODE = p.POS_CODE WHERE e.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' START WITH d.PARENT_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR d.DEPT_ID = d.PARENT_ID
